detail.title: Kernel Governance and Durable Record Mechanisms for WAKE Process Continuity
detail.summary: This revision formalizes evidence regarding the integration of repository environment structures with WAKE's durable record persistence, verifying that WAKE continuity is supported by both structural environment enforcement (devcontainer) and programmatic state handling in the kernel.
detail.reason: Incorporating structural environment evidence to provide a more comprehensive view of WAKE continuity mechanisms beyond the kernel records alone.
